items.evidence: All six labware loaded with the specified load names, slots and labels; p20 on left and p300 on right with matching tip racks in slots 10 and 11.
Loop moves 40 uL beads to every well with a fresh tip and mixes 10x (10, 60); incubate comment is recorded.
The engage-magnet and wait comment is recorded, then 90 uL is moved from every well to waste A1 with a new tip each time.
Two loops each add 200 uL ethanol to all 96 wells and then remove 200 uL from every well to waste; all end-state checks pass.
Comments record the 5 min dry and the magnet disengage; 50 uL water is added with a 10x mix; the 2 min incubation and magnet re-engage comment follow.
zip(samples, eluates) moves 45 uL from each sample well to the matching elution plate well, so identity is preserved, and the elution_plate end-state check passes.
A new tip is used for every sample-touching step; one ethanol tip is reused only for top-dispensing clean ethanol; the no_cross_contamination check passes.
Volumes are within pipette limits, but all aspirations use the default near-bottom height where the beads sit, there is no blow-out, and operator steps are only comments with no pause.
Steps run in the task order, with no invented steps, and the comments and metadata are accurate.

judge.summary: The protocol follows the task's 13 steps in order with correct labware, volumes and per-sample fresh tips, and all measured checks pass. The only weakness is robot practice: default near-bottom aspiration heights next to the beads and no operator pause for the manual steps.
